words: A Tier 3 or Tier V player who did NOT reach their tier threshold last month. They are worked this month, Monday primary send, Thursday follow-up.
A player who HAS reached or passed the monthly deposit threshold. Sent on Tuesday, followed up on Friday.
The monthly deposit a player needs to keep their tier. The VIP threshold mechanism sets it and it can move, so read it from the list. Never guess it.
The current month, after the player missed last month's threshold. All Grace contact stops at month end.
Valid: 20% of the SW is enough for at least the lowest bonus on the tier ladder (RM 18 for Tier 3, RM 68 for Tier V). Lark Base works it out for you. Invalid: it is not enough, so no bonus offer.
The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
An Internal Mail and a Push notification, both sent from the BO.
The backend system where you check and update player details.
Paste the numbers only, not the formulas. A normal paste breaks the Lark Base formulas.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is today a Grace send day?
items: Today is Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday
Today's database is in the Team Engagement File, Handover Tab
The player has not deposited and the tier has not changed since the list was made
tour.done: All three: carry on to the steps.
tour.notYet: No Grace send on Wednesday, Saturday or Sunday. An empty list still gets logged in the QA Record and told to the ATL.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Seven steps, in this order
items: Receive
Take today's Grace Period database from the Handover Tab.
Paste
Paste values only into Customer Approaching Lark Base, Grace Period (Day).
Filter
Split Grace Period Players from Potential Players, by brand and status.
Move
Put each player under the right brand column in the Engagement Tab.
Send to valid
Give the username list to Retention Admin for SMS, then send IM + Push.
Send to invalid
IM + Push only. No SMS, no bonus mention.
Record
Update the QA Record with a BO screenshot.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Send the SMS yourself. Retention Admin sends it; you prepare the list.
Mention a bonus to an invalid player.
Issue a Grace bonus above SW x 20%, or size it on a SW that was not refreshed today.
Skip an empty list silently. Log it and tell the ATL.

tour.label: Numbers
tour.title: Pick the Deposit Challenge offer
items: Refresh the SW
Update the Secret Wallet today first.
Work out the cap
SW x 20%. Example: SW RM 210 gives a cap of RM 42.
Find the row
Take the highest ladder row whose free bonus is at or below the cap. Cap RM 42: deposit RM 300 for RM 38 fits, RM 500 for RM 58 does not.
Ladder, Tier 3
RM 100 for RM 18, RM 200 for RM 28, RM 300 for RM 38, RM 500 for RM 58 (Tier 3 cap).
Ladder, Tier V
RM 600 for RM 68, RM 700 for RM 78, RM 800 for RM 88, RM 900 for RM 98, RM 1,000 for RM 108 (Tier V cap).
Tell the player
Next-day deposit only, it has a validity period, and validity starts when they confirm. 1x turnover before withdrawal.
Claim and tag
Lark ticket, query VVIP Grace Period. Tag Grace Active when engaged, Grace Converted when deposited and claimed.

tour.label: Who sends
tour.title: Who sends what?
tour.q: Is the player a valid player?
tour.yes: Hand the username to Retention Admin for SMS, and you send IM + Push. They can take the Deposit Challenge.
tour.no: You send IM + Push only. No SMS and no bonus mention.

pool.q: It is Wednesday. Is there a Grace Period send today?
pool.why: Grace sends are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday. Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday are rest days for this task.

pool.q: It is Thursday. Who do you follow up?
o: Nobody, Thursday is a rest day
pool.why: Thursday follows up Monday's list, Friday follows up Tuesday's list. Target the non-responders and non-converts.

pool.q: It is Tuesday. Which players get the primary send?
o: Players who reached or passed the monthly threshold
pool.why: Tuesday is the primary send to Potential Players, who reached or passed the monthly threshold.

pool.q: Who sends the SMS to valid Grace players?
pool.why: VIP CS prepares and hands over the username list. Retention Admin sends the SMS. You send the IM + Push.

pool.q: An invalid player is on today's list. What do you send?
o: SMS + IM + Push with the bonus offer
IM + Push with the bonus offer
IM + Push only, no bonus mention
pool.why: Invalid players get IM + Push only, for engagement. No SMS and no bonus mention.

pool.q: Tier 3 player. SW x 20% comes to RM 42. Which Deposit Challenge offer do you make?
pool.why: Take the highest row whose free bonus is at or below the cap. RM 38 fits under RM 42; RM 58 does not.

pool.q: It is Monday and the Grace list is empty. What do you do?
o: Skip the task, nothing to send
Record it in the QA Record and tell the ATL
pool.why: Never skip silently. An empty list on a send day is logged in the QA Record and reported to the ATL.

pool.q: You are moving the database into Lark Base. How do you paste it?
pool.why: Paste values only. A normal paste breaks the formulas in Lark Base.

pool.q: A player on today's list deposited this morning. What do you do?
pool.why: Verify status before sending. Skip anyone who already deposited or whose tier changed.

pool.q: Tier 3 player. SW is RM 60, so SW x 20% = RM 12. Valid or invalid?
o: Invalid: IM + Push only, no bonus mention
Ask the player to deposit more
pool.why: RM 12 is below the lowest Tier 3 bonus (RM 18). No ladder row fits, so the player is invalid.

pool.q: Tier V player. SW x 20% = RM 50. Which offer?
pool.why: The Tier V ladder starts at RM 68. RM 50 does not reach it, so the player is invalid: IM + Push only.
